episode_gain_summary.distinction: The arithmetic mean of 141 per-episode percentage reductions differs from 100*(population mean AR MSE - population mean ShiftWM MSE)/population mean AR MSE. The latter is the reported 5.2997565% overall reduction; do not label the mean episode percentage as the overall reduction.

metric.coordinates: 4x4 DINOv2 feature grid, standardized with training-only shared-channel statistics
metric.episode_aggregation: Mean eligible h10 windows within each episode, then equal mean of the three seeds
metric.name: native_h10_feature_mse
metric.population_aggregation: Equal weight per episode and per seed; 1631 windows are not pooled with unequal episode weights

overall_registered_paired_contrast.bootstrap_units: recording sessions and training seeds, paired
overall_registered_paired_contrast.scope: exploratory original validation; no multiple-comparison adjustment

photo_selection.boundary: Recorded observations/target only. The shown median window regresses, despite positive episode gain; do not present its photographed task as a successful ShiftWM-controlled action or generated prediction.

prespecified_rule.episode_aggregation: mean complete windows within each episode, then equal mean of three seeds
prespecified_rule.error_map: mean squared standardized error per patch over 384 channels, then mean of three seeds
prespecified_rule.error_scale: linear zero to maximum of all six displayed endpoint maps, no percentile clipping
prespecified_rule.frames: three observed support frames and tenth-query target, at recorded native frame indices
prespecified_rule.publication_gate: candidate only; completed verified 15-model campaign plus numeric checks plus actual visual review
prespecified_rule.regression_label: use largest regression only when minimum episode gain is strictly negative
prespecified_rule.replay_window: smallest eligible h10 window_start; never reselect for visual advantage
prespecified_rule.transport_panel: mean three-seed h10 row of transport matrix for fixed target patch (1,1); show its gate separately

rank_strip.interpretation: Descriptive signs of three-seed-averaged episode endpoint error; not a success rate, per-episode significance test or generalization rate.
rank_strip.order: Descending episode gain; ascending episode_id breaks ties

scope: Original DROID development validation, not independent held-out or robot-control evaluation.
